note: BLUEPRINT_v2 4, P1 (the state, organs, offices, powers) and P2's first machine constraints. Sources: the Constitution of Japan (articles as cited), the Cabinet Act, the Diet Act, the Public Finance Act. A power is an operation an organ may perform; an act is refused when its organ lacks the power or its procedure is not met. Japan only; other states keep their own (none built yet).

diet.name: 国会
diet.basis: art. 41: the highest organ of state power and the sole law-making organ

house_of_representatives.name: 衆議院
house_of_representatives.basis: art. 45; Public Offices Election Act (289 single-member districts + 176 proportional)

cabinet.name: 内閣
cabinet.basis: art. 65: executive power; art. 66: collective responsibility to the Diet

prime_minister.name: 内閣総理大臣
prime_minister.basis: art. 67: designated by the Diet from its members; art. 68: appoints and removes ministers

supreme_court.name: 最高裁判所
supreme_court.basis: art. 76: judicial power; art. 81: constitutional review

emperor.name: 天皇
emperor.basis: art. 1 symbol; arts. 6-7 acts in matters of state with the advice and approval of the Cabinet (no political power)

prime_minister.term: while the Diet's confidence holds (art. 69) and the member's seat holds

submit_bill.basis: Cabinet Act art. 5: the PM submits bills on behalf of the Cabinet

submit_budget.basis: art. 73(5), art. 86: the Cabinet prepares and submits the budget

enact_law.basis: art. 59: passage by both houses; the lower house may override with two thirds

pass_budget.basis: art. 60: lower house precedence; its decision prevails after 30 days

cabinet_order.basis: art. 73(6): cabinet orders to execute the law, no penalties without a law's delegation

dissolve_lower_house.basis: art. 7 (advice to the Emperor) and art. 69

no_confidence.basis: art. 69: the Cabinet resigns or dissolves within 10 days

amend_constitution.basis: art. 96: two thirds of each house, then a referendum majority

use_reserve_fund.basis: art. 87: the reserve fund on the Cabinet's responsibility, with the Diet's later approval

set_tax_rate.basis: art. 84: no tax without a law

spend_public_money.basis: art. 85: expenditure only by the Diet's resolution

refuses: a lever that changes a tax rate without enact_law
a lever that adds spending beyond the budget and the reserve fund without pass_budget
a PM whose party and partners hold less than a majority, unless designated by a majority vote

election_within_40_days.effect: after a dissolution the general election is within 40 days and the Diet convenes within 30 days after

art_9.constraint: no war potential beyond self-defence (public surface only: budget share, personnel)

party_positions.note: T: declared party stances on the levers that need a law, by their 2024 platforms as reported (S where quoted): the governing parties vote yes on their own bills; a consumption-tax RISE is opposed by every opposition party; a tax CUT is backed by DPFP, Ishin, Reiwa, JCP, CDP (2024 platforms). Positions by lever: 'yes' | 'no'; a party not listed votes with its bloc (governing yes, opposition no).

partners.note: T: standing coalition partners for the PM designation after an election (art. 67); broader bargaining is S4'
